item.title: GTA VI Launches November 19: The Questions Everyone Is Asking, the Ones They Aren’t, and How to Prepare
item.description: Pre-loading is open, the unlock is at local midnight and the download is up to 212 GB. Here is what to know, what almost nobody asks and how to get ready, step by step.

item.description: A $25 million Western-noir with almost no music, a killer with a coin and a villain who nearly went to another actor became the Coen brothers’ biggest hit of its time and the last Western to…

item.title: Today in Cinema, November 8: 8 Mile Opens in 2002 and Turns a Detroit Rap Battle Into an Oscar-Winning Anthem
item.description: A music video on MTV, a director chosen over Tarantino and Danny Boyle, and a song written during rehearsals produced the film that made Eminem the first solo rapper to win an Academy Award.

item.title: How to Film, Direct and Produce Your Own Movie: A Complete Guide for First-Time Filmmakers
item.description: From a one-sentence idea to a finished film: the planning, shooting and editing decisions that decide whether a first movie gets made, and how to make each one earlier and cheaper.

item.title: The Flintstones (1994): How It Was Made, Effects and Box Office
item.description: How Brian Levant, Jim Henson’s Creature Shop and a desert full of foam built a live-action Stone Age, and why a movie critics disliked earned nearly $342 million.

item.description: A $100 million blockbuster that critics read as propaganda, a director who refused to finish the novel and a test reel that fooled studio executives: the story of the 1997 film that took two…

item.description: How Mike Nichols turned a wedding-crash rescue into one of cinema’s most debated final shots.

item.description: Six months after Reloaded, the Wachowskis closed their trilogy with a record-setting global opening, a record-setting drop and an ending that critics and fans have argued about for 23 years.

item.title: Matt Damon Actor Spotlight: Performance, Pivots, Filmography
item.description: An analytical deep-dive into the performance mechanics, career pivots and filmography weight of Hollywood’s most calculated everyman.
